name: ibis Surabaya City Center
short_description: A budget-friendly ibis in the heart of Surabaya's main business area with 24-hour service, free high-speed Wi-Fi, and direct transport connections to the airport.
ai_summary: ibis Surabaya City Center is an economy hotel under Accor's ibis brand located in the main business area of Surabaya. The property offers 24-hour room service, free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout, and is positioned with convenient public transport access between the hotel and Juanda International Airport. It sits within minutes of Surabaya's commercial office district and the Tunjungan Plaza shopping complex. As an ibis property, guests can expect the brand's consistent essentials: clean, compact rooms, a 24-hour reception, and on-site casual dining. It is the value pick among Surabaya's Accor properties, suited to travellers who prioritise location and price over in-room space or hotel amenities. For ALL Accor elite members, standard ibis-level programme benefits apply: welcome drink for Silver and above, room upgrades for Platinum and Diamond subject to availability, and early check-in and late check-out for Diamond.

core_facts.address: Jalan Basuki Rahmat, Surabaya, East Java, Indonesia
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: Central Surabaya location in the main business area, minutes from commercial offices and Tunjungan Plaza
24-hour room service and free high-speed Wi-Fi — practical for business travellers on tight schedules
Direct transport links between the hotel and Juanda International Airport
The most affordable Accor loyalty option in central Surabaya
cons: Economy-tier ibis — rooms are compact and functional, with no pool, fitness centre, or premium amenities
Standard ALL elite recognition — no lounge, no guaranteed upgrades beyond programme minimum
City-centre location means traffic noise can be a factor in street-facing rooms
